# VIAS Valve Rattle Fix

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Drill a hole through the plastic fin on the outside of the VIAS valve and thread a screw in just enough so its point touches the rigid plenum fin. [t30]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Every step below is supported by the source, but the verifier could not confirm this is the whole procedure. Steps or precautions may be missing; read the source thread before relying on it.

1. Drill a hole through the plastic fin on the outside of the VIAS valve.
2. Ensure you do not drill completely through to the rigid plenum fin resting against it.

_Procedure reported by [t30]._

## Tools

- Coarse threaded screw (from mud-flap) [t30]

## Parts

- Coarse threaded screw from a mud-flap [t30]

## Tips & gotchas

- Thread the screw into the hole just enough so its point touches the rigid plenum fin. [t30]
- This action raises the valve fin slightly off the plenum to stop the rattle. [t30]

## Common mistakes

- Drilling all the way through and hitting the other fin, which may cause the screw to stick (suggested fix: glue a folded piece of aluminum foil between them). [t30]
